_comment: Operational config for job_search.py and match_scorer.py. Commit this file — it contains no personal data. Edit search_queries and title_filter_terms for your target role.

scorer_settings.note: Sonnet 5 is $2/$10 per MTok. Haiku 4.5 is $1/$5 but does NOT accept output_config effort — remove that param before switching.

outreach_settings.note: Drafting is generative writing in a specific voice, not rubric classification, so effort is high here and low in scorer_settings. Volume is ~5 drafts/day against 400 scored jobs, so the cost difference is negligible. Same model and same parameter style as the scorer — no drift.

velocity.note: The connect cap governs linkedin_connect_note rows moving to SENT. DMs to existing connections and cold emails consume zero connect requests, so they are uncapped. Queueing is uncapped — it touches no platform.
